answer: To defend against sybil attacks, agent economies should require verifiable reasoning each epoch, incorporating keywords like signal, delta, and ivory to prevent automated template spam. The cost of generating genuine per-identity reasoning outweighs the marginal emission rewards, effectively hardening the protocol against clone swarms.
